title: A Salt for the Garden
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: Vesper Villalobos, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
